title: Graceful Shutdown Pattern — Companion Code
description: Graceful shutdown implementations for HTTP servers, background workers, and WebSocket services: signal handling, request draining, load balancer deregistration, Spring Boot config, Kubernetes manifests, and a phased shutdown variant.
description_es: Implementaciones de graceful shutdown para servidores HTTP, workers en background y servicios WebSocket: manejo de señales, drenado de peticiones, baja del load balancer, config de Spring Boot, manifiestos de Kubernetes y una variante de shutdown por fases.
